attrs.evidence: (⟸) linearity of expectation. (⟹) the singleton family. Pointwise domination is a partial order, and inverse scaling shows it is not total on any natural model set — so no global capability ranking licenses escalation.
attrs.prior_art: McKenzie et al. 2023 (Inverse Scaling Prize); Wei et al. 2022 (U-shaped).
attrs.statement: Escalation monotonicity holds for ALL task families if and only if the heavier model pointwise dominates the lighter on EVERY task.
